title: No Sleep, All Gas

Deep tuned 808 bass, polished punchy kick and snare, detailed rolling hi hats, lush dark electric piano, cinematic synth pads, restrained guitar motifs, evolving arrangement, dynamic build and hook, spacious professional stereo mix, controlled low end and radio-ready master. Absolutely no impersonation or imitation of a specific artist, no samples from existing songs. Vocals must be prominent throughout; not instrumental, not spoken-word TTS.
